subject: Information Theory
title: Information Cascades
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Information Cascades.

hook.text: A restaurant is empty. You walk past. The next person walks past because you did. Soon everyone avoids it—no real data.

buildup.text: Information cascades occur when people follow others' actions rather than their own private information.

discovery.text: Once a cascade starts, private information is drowned out. Wrong decisions persist because everyone copies each other.

twist.text: Cascades are fragile. A single credible dissenter revealing private information can collapse the entire chain.

climax.text: Social media accelerates cascades. Viral content spreads through imitation, not evaluation. Speed amplifies fragility.

punchline.text: Follow the crowd, ignore your data. Cascades amplify mistakes.

quiz.question: What causes an information cascade?
options: People follow others' actions instead of their own private information
